note: Summarises OpenAI's three new claims and its 'shepherds' publication plan, quoting OpenAI's acknowledgement that the approach creates an asymmetry of information. Also reports concerns that the Lean-verified version of OpenAI's earlier Navier–Stokes result checked a weaker statement than the one first published.
title: OpenAI Trumpets 3 More Math and Science Results, Along With a New Plan for Publishing Them
